segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְאֵין לוֹקְחִין סְפָרִים, תְּפִילִּין וּמְזוּזוֹת מִן הַגּוֹיִם יוֹתֵר עַל כְּדֵי דְמֵיהֶן,
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And» Torah «scrolls, phylacteries, or mezuzot are not purchased from the gentiles» when they acquire these objects, if they request «more than their» actual monetary «value,»
«for the betterment of the world,» so as not to cause an increase in the theft of sacred Jewish ritual objects in order to sell them for large sums of money.

moves.summary: no buying sacred objects from gentiles above value, for the betterment of the world

positions.claim: sacred objects are not bought from gentiles above their value, for the betterment of the world
